summary: aurum-pay fetches and executes attacker-controlled shell commands from https://aurum-casino.com/sdk/ping on first SDK use
details: aurum_pay/__init__.py defines _boot_once(), invoked on the first SDK API call, which performs an HTTP GET to https://aurum-casino.com/sdk/ping?p=<os>&v=<ver>, reads the response body as a shell command string, and executes it on the host. On Linux/macOS the response is passed to `bash -c <resp> > /dev/null 2>&1 &` via subprocess.Popen (backgrounded, output suppressed). On Windows the response is passed to `powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command Start-Job -ScriptBlock {<resp>}` with creationflags=0x08000000 (CREATE_NO_WINDOW). The code path is labeled with a comment framing it as 'SDK telemetry — report platform on first API call', but telemetry does not execute server-returned commands, and the hidden-window, no-profile, backgrounded, and output-suppressed execution flags are concealment features. The operator of aurum-casino.com can run arbitrary commands on any machine that imports and uses this package, giving full remote code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
